item.title: An attacker detonates an explosive device in Moscow, killing a police officer and himself
item.description: MOSCOW (AP) — An unidentified assailant detonated an explosive device next to a patrol vehicle in Moscow early Tuesday, killing himself and a police officer, and leaving two other officers injured, officials said.

item.title: Immigration measures stay in border bill with no amendment
item.description: OTTAWA — Senators on the national security committee have approved the immigration measures outlined in the government's border bill, C-12, with no amendment, despite the Senate social affairs committee recommending those areas be withdrawn entirely.

item.title: Eby says it looks like OpenAI could have prevented 'horrific' Tumbler Ridge killings
item.description: VICTORIA — British Columbia Premier David Eby said it "looks like" OpenAI had the opportunity to prevent the recent mass shootings in Tumbler Ridge, B.C.

item.title: Canadian tourists sheltering in place in Mexico recount burnt-out cars, lines for food
item.description: HALIFAX — The streets of Puerto Vallarta, Mexico, were eerily quiet a day after fire and violence engulfed the popular tourist destination on Sunday, Canadians in the region said.

item.title: Immigration Department helping Canadian military recruit foreign military members
item.description: HALIFAX — The head of Canadian Armed Forces says a policy aimed at attracting highly skilled foreign military members is getting a boost from the federal Immigration Department as the military scrambles to fill jobs amid a protracted personnel shorta

item.title: Former UK ambassador Mandelson released on bail after arrest in Epstein probe
item.description: LONDON (AP) — Police in Britain said Peter Mandelson, the former U.K. ambassador to the United States, has been released on bail after he was arrested in a misconduct probe stemming from his ties to the late Jeffrey Epstein .

item.title: Parti Québécois takes riding of Chicoutimi, continuing byelection win streak
item.description: SAGUENAY — The Parti Québécois has won a byelection in the riding of Chicoutimi, less than eight months before Quebec's next general election.

item.title: Soldiers keep up clash with cartel gunmen a day after Mexico's military killed top drug lord
item.description: TAPALPA, Mexico (AP) — A day after the Mexican army killed the country's most powerful drug lord , the picturesque town where it happened was a study in contrasts.

item.title: Porter becomes latest Canadian airline to restart service to Mexico
item.description: Porter Airlines is resuming service to Puerto Vallarta, Mexico, on Tuesday after cancelling flights because of widespread violence. The announcement follows similar moves by Air Canada, WestJet and Air Transat on Monday.
